name: SkyRewrite
description: Tune SkyRewrite journal, Local Echo, bounty, and guard response behavior. Numeric settings show their limits and accept typed values within those limits.

settings.label: Open SkyRewrite
settings.description: Open the SkyRewrite dashboard.

settings.label: Live history update delay
settings.description: Wait this long after the latest recorded action, then refresh the visible history once.

settings.label: Show observed activity by location
settings.description: Show or hide the activity summary on the overview.

settings.label: Include inventory transfers in history
settings.description: Show item movement events in the journal.

settings.label: Journal retention
settings.description: Older rows are pruned first; saved lifetime totals remain.

settings.label: Enable Local Echo on revisit
settings.description: Record an Echo when recent weighted activity reaches its threshold.

settings.label: Local Echo pressure threshold
settings.description: Recent activity needed to record an Echo.

settings.label: Local Echo lookback
settings.description: How far back recent activity contributes to pressure, in-game days.

settings.label: Local Echo cooldown
settings.description: Minimum time before the same location can record another Echo, in-game days.

settings.label: Show an in-game Echo notice
settings.description: Show a short HUD message when an Echo is recorded.

settings.label: Adaptive guard confidence response
settings.description: Eligible guards become one confidence step braver for one in-game day after repeated hostile losses.

settings.label: Add a temporary hold bounty on Echo
settings.description: Add a temporary nonviolent bounty when an eligible Echo fires.

settings.label: Echo bounty eligible victim type
settings.description: Choose which saved victim context qualifies an Echo bounty.

settings.label: Temporary hold bounty amount
settings.description: Nonviolent bounty added by an Echo, in septims.

settings.label: Temporary hold bounty duration
settings.description: How long the Echo bounty remains before a safe expiry attempt, in-game days.

settings.label: Scale bounty with local pressure
settings.description: Scale the configured amount by pressure, rounded to 5 septims and capped at 100.

settings.label: Add a bounty after repeated thefts
settings.description: Let repeated thefts at one location trigger a nonviolent hold bounty.

settings.label: Theft bounty amount
settings.description: Amount attempted after the theft threshold is reached, in septims.

settings.label: Theft events before bounty
settings.description: Theft events in one location and lookback window required for a bounty attempt.

settings.label: Dispatch a matching hold guard
settings.description: Ask SkyRewrite to dispatch a guard when it applies a hold bounty.
